    t.server) (hto : ts.s.timeout i = some s2) (hrole : (t.line ts.l).ev.role = Etcdraft.candidate)
    (hcand : (s2.s i).state = Etcdraft.candidate) (hterm : (s2.s i).currentTerm = (t.line

theorem TraceSim.sim_recordVote (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (src :
    w64) (v : Bool) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hc : s.role = Role.candidate) :
    TraceSim.SimServerR C bl { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes
    := recordVote s.votes src v, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit :=
    s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } { currentTerm := a.currentTerm, state := a.state,
    votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := a.lead, log := a.log, commitIndex := a.commitIndex,
    votesResponded := a.votesResponded.add (TraceSim.idAbs src), votesGranted := if v = true then
    a.votesGranted.add (TraceSim.idAbs src) else a.votesGranted, matchIndex := a.matchIndex,
    pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_accept (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C
    : List w64) (bl p : Nat) (L ents : List EntryM) (hlog : (st.s i).log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L)
    (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hq : p +
    ents.length ≤ L.length) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < ↑p + 1) (hne : ents ≠ []) (hsub : m.subtype
    ≠ "heartbeat") (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 L) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) (hnc
    : ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < L.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' L[p +
    k]? = some e.Term') : st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j (↑p + 1) m = some ((st.commitTo i (min
    m.commitIndex (↑p + ↑ents.length))).reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse,
    subtype := m.subtype, term := (st.s i).currentTerm, success := true, matchIndex := ↑p +
    ↑ents.length, source := i, dest := j } m)

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_cons (it : Etcdraft.Msg × Nat) (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) :
    Etcdraft.Bag.count (it :: b) m = if it.fst = m then it.snd else b.count m

def TraceSim.withMatch (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (mi : Int) : Etcdraft.State :=
  st.upd i fun w =>
    { currentTerm := w.currentTerm, state := w.state, votedFor := w.votedFor, lead := w.lead, log := w.log,
      commitIndex := w.commitIndex, votesResponded := w.votesResponded, votesGranted := w.votesGranted,
      matchIndex := fun k => if k = j then max ((st.s i).matchIndex j) mi else w.matchIndex k,
      pendingConfChangeIndex := w.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := w.config, durable := w.durable }

theorem TraceSim.subSeqM_drop (l : List Etcdraft.Entry) (d : Nat) : Etcdraft.subSeqM l (↑d + 1)
    ↑l.length = Except.ok (List.drop d l)

theorem TraceSim.appendEntries_send (st : Etcdraft.State) (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (id
    : w64) (m : Msg) (k : Nat) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s (st.s (TraceSim.idAbs id))) (hl :
    s.role = Role.leader) (hs : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) (hty : m.ty = MsgType.app) (hsrc : m.src =
    id) (hdst : m.dst ≠ id) (hC : m.dst ∈ C) (hterm : m.term = s.term) (hpk : uint.nat m.index + k ≤
    s.log.length) (hlt : plogTermAt s.base s.log m.index = some m.logterm) (hents : m.entries =
    List.take k (List.drop (uint.nat m.index) s.log)) (hcommit : m.commit = s.commit) :
    st.appendEntries (TraceSim.idAbs id) (TraceSim.idAbs m.dst) (↑(uint.nat m.index) + 1)
    (↑(uint.nat m.index) + 1 + ↑k) = Except.ok (some (st.send ((TraceSim.msgAbs C bl m).get ⋯)))

theorem TraceSim.specQuorum_iff (C : List w64) (hnd : C.Nodup) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a :
    Etcdraft.Server) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hl : s.role = Role.leader) (k : Nat) (hk1
    : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < 2 ^ 64) : Etcdraft.isQuorum (List.filter (fun x => decide (a.matchIndex x ≥
    ↑k)) a.config.incoming) a.config.incoming = true ↔ IsQuorum (listToSet C) (ackedBy s (W64 ↑k))

theorem TraceSim.tallyGranted_empty : TraceSim.TallyGranted ∅ []

theorem TraceSim.sim_commitTo (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (c : w64)
    (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl { term := s.term, vote := s.vote,
    lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log :=
    s.log, commit := plogCommitTo s.commit c, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } { currentTerm :=
    a.currentTerm, state := a.state, votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := a.lead, log := a.log,
    commitIndex := max a.commitIndex (uint.Z c), votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted :=
    a.votesGranted, matchIndex := a.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex,
    config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.sim_higherTerm (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (t :
    w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (ht : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z t) : TraceSim.SimServerR C
    bl (pbecomeFollower s t (W64 0)) { currentTerm := uint.Z t, state := Etcdraft.follower, votedFor
    := if (a.currentTerm != uint.Z t) = true then Etcdraft.nil else a.votedFor, lead :=
    Etcdraft.nil, log := a.log, commitIndex := a.commitIndex, votesResponded := a.votesResponded,
    votesGranted := a.votesGranted, matchIndex := a.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex :=
    a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.filterMap_id_of {α : Type} (f : α → Option α) (l : List α) : (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → f
    x = some x) → List.filterMap f l = l

def TraceSim.voteRespResult (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) :
    Etcdraft.State :=
  (st.upd i fun w =>
        { currentTerm := w.currentTerm, state := w.state, votedFor := w.votedFor, lead := w.lead, log := w.log,
          commitIndex := w.commitIndex, votesResponded := (st.s i).votesResponded.add j,
          votesGranted := if m.voteGranted = true then (st.s i).votesGranted.add j else w.votesGranted,
          matchIndex := w.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := w.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := w.config,
          durable := w.durable }).discard
    m

    (hdst : m.dst ≠ id) (hC : m.dst ∈ C) (hw : s.votes !! m.dst = none) (hterm : m.term = s.term)
    (hidx : m.index = (plogLast s.base s.log).index') (hlt : m.logterm = (plogLast s.base
    s.log).term') : st.requestVote (TraceSim.idAbs id) (TraceSim.idAbs m.dst) = some (st.send
    ((TraceSim.msgAbs C bl m).get ⋯))

    Nat) (lt : w64) (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hpt : m.prevLogTerm = uint.Z lt) (hbl :
    TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 es) (h0 : p = 0 → lt = W64 0) (hp : p < 2 ^ 64) : TraceSim.LogOkL m
    (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es) = decide (PlogMatches { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es { term'
    := lt, index' := W64 ↑p })

    term' := lt, index' := W64 ↑p } ↔ PlogMatches { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es { term' :=
    lt, index' := W64 ↑p }

    List Etcdraft.TState) (hn : t.next f = Except.ok [g]) (hgl : g.l = l0 + 1) (hinv : g.s.violated
    = Except.ok none) : t.stepRound l0 true [f] ([], visited, { }) = Except.ok ([g], visited, [], {
    })

theorem TraceSim.receive_appStale (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hf : (st.s
    m.dest).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm : m.term = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsub :
    m.subtype = "app") (hidx : m.prevLogIndex + 1 ≤ (st.s m.dest).commitIndex) (hlogOk :
    TraceSim.LogOkL m (st.s m.dest).log = true) : st.receive m = Except.ok [TraceSim.withLead
    (st.reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype := m.subtype, term := (st.s
    m.dest).currentTerm, success := true, matchIndex := (st.s m.dest).commitIndex, source := m.dest,
    dest := m.source } m) m.dest m.source]

theorem TraceSim.maxAgree_eq (q : Nat → Bool) (L n : Nat) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hnL : n ≤ L) (hq : q n =
    true) (hmax : ∀ (k : Nat), n < k → k ≤ L → q k = false) : List.foldl (fun acc n => if q (n + 1)
    = true then n + 1 else acc) 0 (List.range L) = n

def TraceSim.AgreeTo (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) : Prop :=
  t'.server = t.server ∧
    (∀ (k : Nat), k ≤ l0 → t'.line k = t.line k) ∧
      t'.bootstrap.getD (l0 - 1) false = t.bootstrap.getD (l0 - 1) false ∧ l0 ≤ t.len ∧ l0 ≤ t'.len

theorem TraceSim.receive_trunc (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C : List w64) (bl p n :
    Nat) (es ents : List EntryM) (hsrv : List.contains st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type =
    Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hf : (st.s m.dest).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm :
    m.term = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsub : m.subtype ≠ "snapshot") (hlog : (st.s m.dest).log =
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take n es)) (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents)
    (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hn : n ≤ es.length) (hpn : p ≤ n) (hc : (st.s m.dest).commitIndex
    < ↑p + 1) (hne : ents ≠ []) (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 es) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p +
    1) ents) (hlogOk : (m.prevLogIndex == 0 || decide (m.prevLogIndex > 0) && decide (m.prevLogIndex
    ≤ ↑(st.s m.dest).log.length) && some m.prevLogTerm == Option.map Etcdraft.Entry.term (st.s
    m.dest).log[(m.prevLogIndex - 1).toNat]?) = true) (hconf : ¬∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? =
    some e → p + k < n → Option.map EntryM.Term' (List.take n es)[p + k]? = some e.Term') :
    st.receive m = Except.ok [TraceSim.truncSt st m.dest m.source (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take
    (n - 1) es))]

theorem TraceSim.confAbs_length (C : List w64) (h : C.Nodup) : List.length (TraceSim.confAbs C) =
    C.length

theorem TraceSim.bootTerms_truncAppend (bl p d : Nat) (es ents : List EntryM) (hpd : p + d ≤
    es.length) (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 es) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) :
    TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 (List.take (p + d) es ++ List.drop d ents)

theorem TraceSim.confAbs_perm (C : List w64) (h : C.Nodup) : List.Perm (TraceSim.confAbs C)
    (List.map TraceSim.idAbs C)

theorem TraceSim.ite_ok_inv {ε α : Type} {c : Bool} {a r : α} {x : Except ε α} (h : (if c = true
    then Except.ok a else x) = Except.ok r) : r = a ∨ x = Except.ok r

def TraceSim.BootTerms (bl first : Nat) (l : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), first + k ≤ bl → l[k]? = some e → e.Term' = W64 1

theorem TraceSim.subSeq_logAbs (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (es : List EntryM) (p k : Nat) (hpk : p + k
    ≤ es.length) : Etcdraft.subSeqM (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es) (↑p + 1) (↑p + ↑k) = Except.ok
    (TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) (List.take k (List.drop p es)))

def TraceSim.LogShapeOk (bl : Nat) (s : PState) : Prop :=
  s.base = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } ∧
    PlogWf s.base s.log ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), k < bl → s.log[k]? = some e → e.Term' = W64 1

theorem TraceSim.findConflict_first (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) (d : Nat) (e : EntryM) :
    ents[d]? = some e → ¬PlogMatches b es (entId e) → (∀ (j : Nat) (e' : EntryM), j < d → ents[j]? =
    some e' → PlogMatches b es (entId e')) → plogFindConflict b es ents = e.Index'

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_heartbeat (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg)
    (hc : 1 ≤ (st.s i).commitIndex) (hsub : m.subtype = "heartbeat") (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = 0)
    (hents : m.entries = []) : st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j (m.prevLogIndex + 1) m = some
    ((st.commitTo i m.commitIndex).reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype
    := "heartbeat", term := (st.s i).currentTerm, success := true, source := i, dest := j } m)

theorem TraceSim.idAbs_inj {a b : w64} : TraceSim.idAbs a = TraceSim.idAbs b ↔ a = b

theorem TraceSim.sim_adoptLeader (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (src :
    w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl (padoptLeader s src) {
    currentTerm := a.currentTerm, state := Etcdraft.follower, votedFor := a.votedFor, lead :=
    TraceSim.idAbs src, log := a.log, commitIndex := a.commitIndex, votesResponded :=
    a.votesResponded, votesGranted := a.votesGranted, matchIndex := a.matchIndex,
    pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.runRel_congr (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (hinit : t'.init = t.init) (n : Nat) (ts :
    Etcdraft.TState) : t.RunRel n ts → (∀ (l : Nat), 1 ≤ l → l ≤ n → TraceSim.AgreeTo t t' l) →
    t'.RunRel n ts ∧ ts.l = n + 1

theorem TraceSim.flatMap_single {α β : Type} [DecidableEq α] (srv : List α) (f : α → List β) (i : α)
    (x : β) (hnd : srv.Nodup) (hi : i ∈ srv) (hfi : f i = [x]) (hfj : ∀ (j : α), j ∈ srv → j ≠ i → f
    j = []) : List.flatMap f srv = [x]

theorem TraceSim.maxAgree_spec (q : Nat → Bool) (L : Nat) : have M := List.foldl (fun acc n => if q
    (n + 1) = true then n + 1 else acc) 0 (List.range L); (M = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ M ∧ M ≤ L ∧ q M = true) ∧ ∀
    (k : Nat), M < k → k ≤ L → q k = false

theorem TraceSim.not_responded (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (w :
    w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hc : s.role = Role.candidate) (hw : s.votes !! w =
    none) : List.contains a.votesResponded (TraceSim.idAbs w) = false

theorem TraceSim.receive_appReject (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains

theorem TraceSim.stepRound_out_l (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (inv : Bool) (frontier : List
    Etcdraft.TState) (st : List Etcdraft.TState × List Etcdraft.TState × Etcdraft.StepInfo) (out
    visited next : List Etcdraft.TState) (info : Etcdraft.StepInfo) (hf : ∀ (f : Etcdraft.TState), f
    ∈ frontier → f.l = l0) (hst : ∀ (x : Etcdraft.TState), x ∈ st.fst → x.l = l0 + 1) (h :
    t.stepRound l0 inv frontier st = Except.ok (out, visited, next, info)) (x : Etcdraft.TState) : x
    ∈ out → x.l = l0 + 1

theorem TraceSim.oneLess_discard (s st' : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hms : st'.messages =
    s.messages) (hnd : s.messages.domain.Nodup) (hm : 0 < s.messages.count m) :
    Etcdraft.oneLessMessage s (st'.discard m) m = true

theorem TraceSim.bootstrapOf_snoc (lines : List Etcdraft.Line) (ln : Etcdraft.Line) (i :
    Etcdraft.ID) (k : Nat) (hk : k < lines.length) : (Etcdraft.bootstrapOf (lines ++ [ln])
    i).fst.getD k false = (Etcdraft.bootstrapOf lines i).fst.getD k false

theorem TraceSim.commitTo_le (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (n : Int) (h : n ≤ (st.s
    i).commitIndex) : st.commitTo i n = st.commitTo i (st.s i).commitIndex

theorem TraceSim.reject_step (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (ht :
    m.term = (st.s i).currentTerm) (hf : (st.s i).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hpv : st.preVote =
    false) (hcq : st.checkQuorum = false) : st.rejectAppendEntriesRequest i j m false = some
    (st.reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype := "app", term := (st.s
    i).currentTerm, source := i, dest := j } m)

theorem TraceSim.next_l (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (r : List Etcdraft.TState) (h :
    t.next ts = Except.ok r) (x : Etcdraft.TState) : x ∈ r → x.l = ts.l ∨ x.l = ts.l + 1

theorem TraceSim.conflict_none (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (index : Int) (m :
    Etcdraft.Msg) (h : st.hasNoConflict i index m.entries = true) : st.conflictAppendEntriesRequest
    i index m = Except.ok none

theorem TraceSim.sim_becomeLeader (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (id :
    w64) (mt : GMap w64 w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hs : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) (hm
    : LeaderMatchOk id s mt) : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl (pbecomeLeader id s mt) { currentTerm :=
    a.currentTerm, state := Etcdraft.leader, votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := TraceSim.idAbs id, log
    := a.log, commitIndex := a.commitIndex, votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted :=
    a.votesGranted, matchIndex := fun j => if j = TraceSim.idAbs id then ↑a.log.length else 0,
    pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.mem_grantedAbs (m : GMap w64 Bool) (x : Etcdraft.ID) : x ∈ List.map (fun p =>
    TraceSim.idAbs p.fst) (List.filter (fun p => p.snd) m.toList) ↔ ∃ k, m !! k = some true ∧
    TraceSim.idAbs k = x

theorem TraceSim.receive_updateTerm (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest ∨ m.type =
    Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse ∨ m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest ∨ m.type =
    Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse) (hterm : (st.s m.dest).currentTerm < m.term) :
    st.receive m = Except.ok [st.becomeFollowerOfTerm m.dest m.term]

theorem TraceSim.appendEntriesToSelf_send (st : Etcdraft.State) (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s :
    PState) (id : w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s (st.s (TraceSim.idAbs id))) (hl : s.role =
    Role.leader) (hs : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) : st.appendEntriesToSelf (TraceSim.idAbs id) = some
    (st.send ((TraceSim.msgAbs C bl (pselfAck id s)).get ⋯))

theorem TraceSim.noConflict_none_len (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (index : Int) (m :
    Etcdraft.Msg) (h : m.prevLogIndex + ↑m.entries.length ≤ ↑(st.s i).log.length) :
    st.noConflictAppendEntriesRequest i index m = Except.ok none

theorem TraceSim.stepRound_stay (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (f g : Etcdraft.TState) (visited :
    List Etcdraft.TState) (hn : t.next f = Except.ok [g]) (hgl : g.l = l0) (hnew : Etcdraft.memEq
    visited g = false) (hinv : g.s.violated = Except.ok none) : t.stepRound l0 true [f] ([],
    visited, { }) = Except.ok ([], visited ++ [g], [g], { })

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_none_conf (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (index : Int) (m :
    Etcdraft.Msg) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < index) (hne : m.entries.isEmpty = false) (h :
    st.hasNoConflict i index m.entries = false) : st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j index m = none

theorem TraceSim.upd_congr (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (f g : Etcdraft.Server →
    Etcdraft.Server) (h : f (st.s i) = g (st.s i)) : st.upd i f = st.upd i g

theorem TraceSim.noConflict_step (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C :
    List w64) (bl p : Nat) (L ents : List EntryM) (hlog : (st.s i).log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L)
    (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hpq : p ≤
    L.length) (hq : L.length < p + ents.length) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < ↑p + 1) (hbl :
    TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 L) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) (hnc : ∀ (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < L.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' L[p + k]? = some
    e.Term') : st.noConflictAppendEntriesRequest i (↑p + 1) m = Except.ok (some (st.upd i fun v => {
    currentTerm := v.currentTerm, state := v.state, votedFor := v.votedFor, lead := v.lead, log :=
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L ++ List.drop (L.length - p) (TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents),
    commitIndex := v.commitIndex, votesResponded := v.votesResponded, votesGranted :=
    v.votesGranted, matchIndex := v.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := v.pendingConfChangeIndex,
    config := v.config, durable := v.durable }))

theorem TraceSim.logAbs_take_ne (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (es : List EntryM) (k k' : Nat) (hk : k ≤
    es.length) (hk' : k' ≤ es.length) (hne : k ≠ k') : TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take k es) ≠
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take k' es)

theorem TraceSim.state_eq_of_log_ne (s t : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (hi : i ∈ s.server) (h
    : (s.s i).log ≠ (t.s i).log) : s.eq t = false

theorem TraceSim.truncAppend_has (es ents : List EntryM) (p d : Nat) (hpd : p + d ≤ es.length) (hbef
    : ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < p + d → Option.map EntryM.Term'
    (List.take (p + d) es)[p + k]? = some e.Term') (k : Nat) (e : EntryM) : ents[k]? = some e → p +
    k < (List.take (p + d) es ++ List.drop d ents).length → Option.map EntryM.Term' (List.take (p +
    d) es ++ List.drop d ents)[p + k]? = some e.Term'

theorem TraceSim.foldl_range_congr {α : Type} (f g : α → Nat → α) (a : α) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ (acc : α)
    (k : Nat), k < n → f acc k = g acc k) : List.foldl f a (List.range n) = List.foldl g a
    (List.range n)

theorem TraceSim.stepLoop_congr (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (inv : Bool) (ha :
    TraceSim.AgreeTo t t' l0) (frontier : List Etcdraft.TState) (st : List Etcdraft.TState × List
    Etcdraft.TState × Etcdraft.StepInfo) (r : Etcdraft.EvalM (List Etcdraft.TState ×
    Etcdraft.StepInfo)) : t.StepLoop l0 inv frontier st r → (∀ (f : Etcdraft.TState), f ∈ frontier →
    f.l = l0) → (∀ (x : Etcdraft.TState), x ∈ st.fst → x.l = l0 + 1) → t'.StepLoop l0 inv frontier
    st r ∧ ∀ (out : List Etcdraft.TState) (info : Etcdraft.StepInfo), r = Except.ok (out, info) → ∀
    (x : Etcdraft.TState), x ∈ out → x.l = l0 + 1

theorem TraceSim.lastTerm_logAbs (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (h : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl
    s) : Etcdraft.lastTerm (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 s.log) = uint.Z (plogLast s.base s.log).term'

theorem TraceSim.isQuorum_filter_confAbs (C : List w64) (h : C.Nodup) (P : Etcdraft.ID → Bool) :
    Etcdraft.isQuorum (List.filter P (TraceSim.confAbs C)) (TraceSim.confAbs C) = decide
    ((List.filter (fun j => P (TraceSim.idAbs j)) C).length * 2 > C.length)

theorem TraceSim.plastIndex_length (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (h : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) : uint.Z
    (plastIndex s) = ↑s.log.length

theorem TraceSim.stepRound_next_l (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (inv : Bool) (frontier : List
    Etcdraft.TState) (st : List Etcdraft.TState × List Etcdraft.TState × Etcdraft.StepInfo) (out
    visited next : List Etcdraft.TState) (info : Etcdraft.StepInfo) (hf : ∀ (f : Etcdraft.TState), f
    ∈ frontier → f.l = l0) (h : t.stepRound l0 inv frontier st = Except.ok (out, visited, next,
    info)) (x : Etcdraft.TState) : x ∈ next → x.l = l0

theorem TraceSim.noConflict_none_conf (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (index : Int) (m :
    Etcdraft.Msg) (h : st.hasNoConflict i index m.entries = false) :
    st.noConflictAppendEntriesRequest i index m = Except.ok none

theorem TraceSim.lastIndex_plogLast (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (h : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) : uint.Z
    (plogLast s.base s.log).index' = ↑s.log.length

theorem TraceSim.checkLine_of_chain (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts tsF : Etcdraft.TState) (h :
    TraceSim.Chain t ts.l [ts] ts tsF) : t.CheckLineRel true [ts] ([], { }) (Except.ok ([tsF], { }))

theorem TraceSim.nonReceive_becomeLeader (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (i :
    Etcdraft.ID) (s2 : Etcdraft.State) (hl : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hname : (t.line ts.l).ev.name =
    "BecomeLeader") (hnid : (t.line ts.l).nid = i) (hnd : List.Nodup t.server) (hi : i ∈ t.server)
    (hbl : ts.s.becomeLeader i = some s2) (hpost : (t.line ts.l).stateMatches s2 i = true) (hrole :
    (t.line ts.l).ev.role = Etcdraft.leader) (hlead : (s2.s i).state = Etcdraft.leader) :
    t.nonReceive ts = Except.ok [s2]

def TraceSim.srvKey (v : Etcdraft.Server) : Int × Etcdraft.Role :=
  (v.currentTerm, v.state)

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_without (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hnd : b.domain.Nodup) (hm
    : 0 < b.count m) : (b.without m).count m + 1 = b.count m

theorem TraceSim.receive_done (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C : List w64) (bl p : Nat)
    (L ents : List EntryM) (hsrv : List.contains st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type =
    Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hf : (st.s m.dest).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm :
    m.term = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsub : m.subtype = "app") (hlog : (st.s m.dest).log =
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L) (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hprev :
    m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hq : p + ents.length ≤ L.length) (hc : (st.s m.dest).commitIndex < ↑p + 1)
    (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 L) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) (hlogOk :
    (m.prevLogIndex == 0 || decide (m.prevLogIndex > 0) && decide (m.prevLogIndex ≤ ↑(st.s
    m.dest).log.length) && some m.prevLogTerm == Option.map Etcdraft.Entry.term (st.s
    m.dest).log[(m.prevLogIndex - 1).toNat]?) = true) (hnc : ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? =
    some e → p + k < L.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' L[p + k]? = some e.Term') : st.receive m =
    Except.ok [TraceSim.withLead ((st.commitTo m.dest (min m.commitIndex (↑p + ↑ents.length))).reply
    { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype := m.subtype, term := (st.s
    m.dest).currentTerm, success := true, matchIndex := ↑p + ↑ents.length, source := m.dest, dest :=
    m.source } m) m.dest m.source]

inductive TraceSim.Chain (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) : List Etcdraft.TState → Etcdraft.TState →
    Etcdraft.TState → Prop
  | TraceSim.Chain.last {t : Etcdraft.Trace} {l0 : Nat} (visited : List Etcdraft.TState) (f tsF :
      Etcdraft.TState) : t.next f = Except.ok [tsF] → tsF.l = l0 + 1 → tsF.s.violated = Except.ok
      none → TraceSim.Chain t l0 visited f tsF
  | TraceSim.Chain.step {t : Etcdraft.Trace} {l0 : Nat} (visited : List Etcdraft.TState) (f g tsF :
      Etcdraft.TState) : t.next f = Except.ok [g] → g.l = l0 → Etcdraft.memEq visited g = false →
      g.s.violated = Except.ok none → TraceSim.Chain t l0 (visited ++ [g]) g tsF → TraceSim.Chain t
      l0 visited f tsF

theorem TraceSim.sim_psendMsgs (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (ms :
    List Msg) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl (psendMsgs s ms) a

theorem TraceSim.nonReceive_ready (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (hl
    : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hname : (t.line ts.l).ev.name = "Ready") (hnid : (t.line ts.l).nid = i) (hnd :
    List.Nodup t.server) (hi : i ∈ t.server) : t.nonReceive ts = Except.ok [ts.s.ready i]

theorem TraceSim.receive_append (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C : List w64) (bl p : Nat)
    (L ents : List EntryM) (hsrv : List.contains st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type =
    Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hf : (st.s m.dest).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm :
    m.term = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsub : m.subtype ≠ "snapshot") (hlog : (st.s m.dest).log =
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L) (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hprev :
    m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hpq : p ≤ L.length) (hq : L.length < p + ents.length) (hc : (st.s
    m.dest).commitIndex < ↑p + 1) (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 L) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p
    + 1) ents) (hlogOk : (m.prevLogIndex == 0 || decide (m.prevLogIndex > 0) && decide
    (m.prevLogIndex ≤ ↑(st.s m.dest).log.length) && some m.prevLogTerm == Option.map
    Etcdraft.Entry.term (st.s m.dest).log[(m.prevLogIndex - 1).toNat]?) = true) (hnc : ∀ (k : Nat)
    (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < L.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' L[p + k]? = some
    e.Term') : st.receive m = Except.ok [TraceSim.truncSt st m.dest m.source (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1
    L ++ List.drop (L.length - p) (TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents))]

theorem TraceSim.state_eq_of_key_ne (s t : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (hi : i ∈ s.server) (h
    : TraceSim.srvKey (s.s i) ≠ TraceSim.srvKey (t.s i)) : s.eq t = false

theorem TraceSim.checkLine_congr (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (inv : Bool) (ha :
    TraceSim.AgreeTo t t' l0) (tss : List Etcdraft.TState) (acc : List Etcdraft.TState ×
    Etcdraft.StepInfo) (r : Etcdraft.EvalM (List Etcdraft.TState × Etcdraft.StepInfo)) :
    t.CheckLineRel inv tss acc r → (∀ (ts : Etcdraft.TState), ts ∈ tss → ts.l = l0) → (∀ (x :
    Etcdraft.TState), x ∈ acc.fst → x.l = l0 + 1) → t'.CheckLineRel inv tss acc r ∧ ∀ (out : List
    Etcdraft.TState) (info : Etcdraft.StepInfo), r = Except.ok (out, info) → ∀ (x :
    Etcdraft.TState), x ∈ out → x.l = l0 + 1

theorem TraceSim.idAbs_zero {a : w64} : TraceSim.idAbs a = Etcdraft.nil ↔ a = W64 0

theorem TraceSim.handleAER_accept (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (X :
    Etcdraft.State) (hf : (st.s i).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm : m.term = (st.s
    i).currentTerm) (hlog : (m.prevLogIndex == 0 || decide (m.prevLogIndex > 0) && decide
    (m.prevLogIndex ≤ ↑(st.s i).log.length) && some m.prevLogTerm == Option.map Etcdraft.Entry.term
    (st.s i).log[(m.prevLogIndex - 1).toNat]?) = true) (hsub : m.subtype ≠ "snapshot") (c n : Option
    Etcdraft.State) (hc : st.conflictAppendEntriesRequest i (m.prevLogIndex + 1) m = Except.ok c)
    (hn : st.noConflictAppendEntriesRequest i (m.prevLogIndex + 1) m = Except.ok n) (hone :
    Etcdraft.somes [st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j (m.prevLogIndex + 1) m, c, n] = [X]) :
    st.handleAppendEntriesRequest i j m = Except.ok [TraceSim.withLead X i j]

theorem TraceSim.bag_mem_domain_with (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) : m ∈ (b.with m).domain

theorem TraceSim.sim_vote_grant (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (src lt
    li : w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hL : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) : have logOk :=
    decide (uint.Z lt > Etcdraft.lastTerm a.log) ||
      decide (uint.Z lt = Etcdraft.lastTerm a.log) && decide (uint.Z li ≥ ↑a.log.length);
  have grantSpec := logOk && (a.votedFor == TraceSim.idAbs src || a.votedFor == Etcdraft.nil && a.lead == Etcdraft.nil);
  (grantSpec = true ↔ PCanVote s src ∧ plogUpToDate s.base s.log { term' := lt, index' := li } = true) ∧
    (grantSpec = true →
      TraceSim.SimServerR C bl
        { term := s.term, vote := src, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
          base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd }
        { currentTerm := a.currentTerm, state := a.state, votedFor := TraceSim.idAbs src, lead := a.lead, log := a.log,
          commitIndex := a.commitIndex, votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted := a.votesGranted,
          matchIndex := a.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config,
          durable := a.durable })

theorem TraceSim.nonReceive_replicate (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (i : Etcdraft.ID)
    (s2 : Etcdraft.State) (hl : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hname : (t.line ts.l).ev.name = "Replicate") (hnid :
    (t.line ts.l).nid = i) (hnd : List.Nodup t.server) (hi : i ∈ t.server) (hcr : ts.s.clientRequest
    i 0 = some s2) : t.nonReceive ts = Except.ok [s2]

theorem TraceSim.advanceCommitIndex_eq (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (C : List w64) (hnd :
    C.Nodup) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s (st.s i)) (hl : s.role =
    Role.leader) (hs : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) (n : w64) (hc : uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z n) (hn :
    uint.Z n ≤ ↑s.log.length) (ht : plogTermAt s.base s.log n = some s.term) (hq : IsQuorum
    (listToSet C) (ackedBy s n)) (hmax : ∀ (k : Nat), uint.Z n < ↑k → k ≤ s.log.length → ¬IsQuorum
    (listToSet C) (ackedBy s (W64 ↑k))) : st.advanceCommitIndex i = some (st.commitTo i (uint.Z n))

theorem Etcdraft.insertSorted.eq_def (id : Etcdraft.ID) (x✝ : Etcdraft.SetIds) :
    Etcdraft.insertSorted id x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => [id] | x :: xs => if id < x then id :: x ::
    xs else if id = x then x :: xs else x :: Etcdraft.insertSorted id xs

theorem TraceSim.isQuorum_ackedBy (C : List w64) (hnd : C.Nodup) (s : PState) (n : w64) (hn : 0 <
    uint.Z n) : IsQuorum (listToSet C) (ackedBy s n) ↔ C.length < 2 * (List.filter (fun j => decide
    (uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z (matchOf s j))) C).length

theorem TraceSim.next_commit (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (s2 :
    Etcdraft.State) (hl0 : ts.l ≠ 0) (hl : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hb : t.bootstrap.getD (ts.l - 1) false =
    false) (hname : (t.line ts.l).ev.name = "Commit") (hnid : (t.line ts.l).nid = i) (hnd :
    List.Nodup t.server) (hi : i ∈ t.server) (hadv : ts.s.advanceCommitIndex i = some s2) (hpost :
    (t.line ts.l).stateMatches s2 i = true) (hrole : (t.line ts.l).ev.role = Etcdraft.leader) (hlead
    : (ts.s.s i).state = Etcdraft.leader) : t.next ts = Except.ok [{ s := s2, l := ts.l + 1, pl :=
    ts.l }]

theorem TraceSim.next_congr (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (hs : t'.server =
    t.server) (hl : ∀ (k : Nat), k ≤ ts.l → t'.line k = t.line k) (hb : t'.bootstrap.getD (ts.l - 1)
    false = t.bootstrap.getD (ts.l - 1) false) (hlen : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hlen' : ts.l ≤ t'.len) :
    t'.next ts = t.next ts

theorem TraceSim.appLogOk_abs (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (es : List EntryM) (p : Nat) (lt : w64) (hbl
    : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 es) (h0 : p = 0 → lt = W64 0) (hp : p < 2 ^ 64) : (↑p == 0 || decide
    (↑p > 0) && decide (↑p ≤ ↑(TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es).length) && some (uint.Z lt) == Option.map
    Etcdraft.Entry.term (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es)[(↑p - 1).toNat]?) = decide (PlogMatches { term'
    := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es { term' := lt, index' := W64 ↑p })

theorem TraceSim.peer_contains (C : List w64) (w : w64) (h : w ∈ C) : List.contains
    ((TraceSim.confAbs C).union []) (TraceSim.idAbs w) = true

theorem TraceSim.oneLess_reply (s st' : Etcdraft.State) (resp m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hms : st'.messages
    = s.messages) (hnd : s.messages.domain.Nodup) (hm : 0 < s.messages.count m) :
    Etcdraft.oneLessMessage s (st'.reply resp m) m = true

theorem TraceSim.plogMatches_base0 (es : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (q : Nat) (hq : uint.Z e.Index' =
    ↑q + 1) : PlogMatches { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es (entId e) ↔ Option.map EntryM.Term'
    es[q]? = some e.Term'

theorem TraceSim.heartbeat_send (st : Etcdraft.State) (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (id :
    w64) (m : Msg) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s (st.s (TraceSim.idAbs id))) (hl : s.role =
    Role.leader) (hty : m.ty = MsgType.heartbeat) (hsrc : m.src = id) (hdst : m.dst ≠ id) (hC :
    m.dst ∈ C) (hterm : m.term = s.term) (hcommit : uint.Z m.commit = min (uint.Z s.commit) (uint.Z
    (matchOf s m.dst))) : st.heartbeat (TraceSim.idAbs id) (TraceSim.idAbs m.dst) = Except.ok (some
    (st.send ((TraceSim.msgAbs C bl m).get ⋯)))

theorem TraceSim.checkLine_single (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts ts' : Etcdraft.TState) (hnext : t.next ts
    = Except.ok [ts']) (hl : ts'.l = ts.l + 1) (hinv : ts'.s.violated = Except.ok none) :
    t.CheckLineRel true [ts] ([], { }) (Except.ok ([ts'], { }))

theorem TraceSim.oneLess_voteReq (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hterm
    : m.term ≤ (st.s i).currentTerm) (hnd : st.messages.domain.Nodup) (hm : 0 < st.messages.count m)
    : Etcdraft.oneLessMessage st (TraceSim.voteReqResult st i j m) m = true

theorem TraceSim.receive_voteReq (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest) (hterm : m.term =
    (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) : st.receive m = Except.ok [TraceSim.voteReqResult st m.dest m.source
    m]

theorem TraceSim.stepRound_congr (t t' : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (inv : Bool) (frontier : List
    Etcdraft.TState) (st : List Etcdraft.TState × List Etcdraft.TState × Etcdraft.StepInfo) (ha :
    TraceSim.AgreeTo t t' l0) (hf : ∀ (f : Etcdraft.TState), f ∈ frontier → f.l = l0) : t'.stepRound
    l0 inv frontier st = t.stepRound l0 inv frontier st

theorem TraceSim.truncSt_truncSt (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (L1 L2 : List
    Etcdraft.Entry) : TraceSim.truncSt (TraceSim.truncSt st i j L1) i j L2 = TraceSim.truncSt st i j
    L2

theorem TraceSim.srvKey_ne_of_state (a b : Etcdraft.Server) (h : a.state ≠ b.state) :
    TraceSim.srvKey a ≠ TraceSim.srvKey b

theorem TraceSim.sim_appAccept (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (src mc
    lastnewi : w64) (es' : List EntryM) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hfol : a.state =
    Etcdraft.follower) : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl (have __src := padoptLeader s src; { term :=
    __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
    outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := es', commit := plogCommitTo s.commit (if
    uint.Z mc < uint.Z lastnewi then mc else lastnewi), matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd })
    { currentTerm := a.currentTerm, state := a.state, votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := TraceSim.idAbs
    src, log := TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es', commitIndex := max a.commitIndex (min (uint.Z mc)
    (uint.Z lastnewi)), votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted := a.votesGranted,
    matchIndex := a.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config :=
    a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.mem_keysAbs (m : GMap w64 Bool) (x : Etcdraft.ID) : x ∈ List.map (fun p =>
    TraceSim.idAbs p.fst) m.toList ↔ ∃ k v, m !! k = some v ∧ TraceSim.idAbs k = x

def TraceSim.truncSt (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (L : List Etcdraft.Entry) :
    Etcdraft.State :=
  TraceSim.withLead
    (st.upd i fun v =>
      { currentTerm := v.currentTerm, state := v.state, votedFor := v.votedFor, lead := v.lead, log := L,
        commitIndex := v.commitIndex, votesResponded := v.votesResponded, votesGranted := v.votesGranted,
        matchIndex := v.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := v.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := v.config,
        durable := v.durable })
    i j

theorem TraceSim.setIds_mk_perm (l : List Etcdraft.ID) (h : l.Nodup) : List.Perm (Etcdraft.SetIds.mk
    l) l

theorem TraceSim.receive_staleVoteReq (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest) (hterm : m.term <
    (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) : st.receive m = Except.ok [st.reply { type :=
    Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse, term := (st.s m.dest).currentTerm, source := m.dest, dest
    := m.source } m]

theorem TraceSim.state_eq_of_term_ne (s t : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (hi : i ∈ s.server) (h
    : (s.s i).currentTerm ≠ (t.s i).currentTerm) : s.eq t = false

theorem TraceSim.receive_heartbeat (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hf : (st.s
    m.dest).state = Etcdraft.follower) (hterm : m.term = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsub :
    m.subtype = "heartbeat") (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = 0) (hents : m.entries = []) (hc : 1 ≤ (st.s
    m.dest).commitIndex) : st.receive m = Except.ok [TraceSim.withLead ((st.commitTo m.dest
    m.commitIndex).reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype := "heartbeat",
    term := (st.s m.dest).currentTerm, success := true, source := m.dest, dest := m.source } m)
    m.dest m.source]

theorem TraceSim.BootTerms.take {bl first : Nat} {l : List EntryM} (h : TraceSim.BootTerms bl first
    l) (n : Nat) : TraceSim.BootTerms bl first (List.take n l)

theorem TraceSim.foldlM_inv_mem {α β ε : Type} (f : α → β → Except ε α) (P : α → Prop) (l : List β)
    (a r : α) : P a → (∀ (a : α) (b : β) (r : α), b ∈ l → P a → f a b = Except.ok r → P r) →
    List.foldlM f a l = Except.ok r → P r

theorem TraceSim.entAbs_term (C : List w64) (bl k : Nat) (e : EntryM) (h : k ≤ bl → e.Term' = W64 1)
    : (TraceSim.entAbs C bl k e).term = uint.Z e.Term'

def TraceSim.LogOkL (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (Lg : List Etcdraft.Entry) : Bool :=
  m.prevLogIndex == 0 ||
    decide (m.prevLogIndex > 0) && decide (m.prevLogIndex ≤ ↑Lg.length) &&
      some m.prevLogTerm == Option.map Etcdraft.Entry.term Lg[(m.prevLogIndex - 1).toNat]?

theorem TraceSim.insertSorted_mem_iff (id x : Etcdraft.ID) (s : Etcdraft.SetIds) : x ∈
    Etcdraft.insertSorted id s ↔ x = id ∨ x ∈ s

def TraceSim.voteReqResult (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) :
    Etcdraft.State :=
  (st.handleRequestVoteRequest i j m).getD st

theorem TraceSim.logAbs_truncAppend (C : List w64) (bl p d : Nat) (es ents : List EntryM) (hq : p +
    d ≤ es.length) : TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take (p + d) es) ++ List.drop d (TraceSim.logAbs C
    bl (p + 1) ents) = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take (p + d) es ++ List.drop d ents)

theorem TraceSim.receive_voteResp (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse) (hterm : m.term =
    (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hcand : (st.s m.dest).state = Etcdraft.candidate) : st.receive m =
    Except.ok [TraceSim.voteRespResult st m.dest m.source m]

theorem TraceSim.sim_append (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (e :
    EntryM) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hb : bl ≤ s.log.length) (he : e.Term' = s.term) :
    TraceSim.SimServerR C bl (pappend s [e]) { currentTerm := a.currentTerm, state := a.state,
    votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := a.lead, log := a.log ++ [{ term := a.currentTerm, type :=
    Etcdraft.EntryType.value, value := Etcdraft.Value.val 0 }], commitIndex := a.commitIndex,
    votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted := a.votesGranted, matchIndex := a.matchIndex,
    pendingConfChangeIndex := a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.setIds_mk_sorted (l : List Etcdraft.ID) : List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2)
    (Etcdraft.SetIds.mk l)

theorem TraceSim.logAbs_getElem? (C : List w64) (bl first : Nat) (l : List EntryM) (k : Nat) :
    (TraceSim.logAbs C bl first l)[k]? = Option.map (TraceSim.entAbs C bl (first + k)) l[k]?

def TraceSim.withLead (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) : Etcdraft.State :=
  st.upd i fun w =>
    { currentTerm := w.currentTerm, state := w.state, votedFor := w.votedFor, lead := j, log := w.log,
      commitIndex := w.commitIndex, votesResponded := w.votesResponded, votesGranted := w.votesGranted,
      matchIndex := w.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex := w.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := w.config,
      durable := w.durable }

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_any (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C :
    List w64) (bl p : Nat) (L ents : List EntryM) (hlog : (st.s i).log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 L)
    (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hprev : m.prevLogIndex = ↑p) (hq : p +
    ents.length ≤ L.length) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < ↑p + 1) (hsub : m.subtype ≠ "heartbeat")
    (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 L) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) (hnc : ∀ (k : Nat)
    (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < L.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' L[p + k]? = some
    e.Term') : st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j (↑p + 1) m = some ((st.commitTo i (min m.commitIndex
    (↑p + ↑ents.length))).reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype :=
    m.subtype, term := (st.s i).currentTerm, success := true, matchIndex := ↑p + ↑ents.length,
    source := i, dest := j } m)

theorem TraceSim.conflict_step (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (C : List
    w64) (bl p n : Nat) (es ents : List EntryM) (hlog : (st.s i).log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1
    (List.take n es)) (hents : m.entries = TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) (hn : n ≤ es.length)
    (hpn : p ≤ n) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < ↑p + 1) (hne : ents ≠ []) (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms
    bl 1 es) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) (hconf : ¬∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]?
    = some e → p + k < n → Option.map EntryM.Term' (List.take n es)[p + k]? = some e.Term') :
    st.conflictAppendEntriesRequest i (↑p + 1) m = Except.ok (some (st.upd i fun v => { currentTerm
    := v.currentTerm, state := v.state, votedFor := v.votedFor, lead := v.lead, log :=
    TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 (List.take (n - 1) es), commitIndex := v.commitIndex, votesResponded :=
    v.votesResponded, votesGranted := v.votesGranted, matchIndex := v.matchIndex,
    pendingConfChangeIndex := v.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := v.config, durable := v.durable }))

theorem TraceSim.maybeAppend_spec (es ents es' : List EntryM) (p : Nat) (lt lastnewi : w64) (hwf : ∀
    (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = ↑p + ↑k + 1) (hp : p < 2 ^ 64)
    (hnw : ↑p + ↑ents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64) (happ : plogMaybeAppend { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0
    } es { term' := lt, index' := W64 ↑p } ents = some (lastnewi, es')) : p ≤ es.length ∧ uint.Z
    lastnewi = ↑p + ↑ents.length ∧ ((es' = es ∧ p + ents.length ≤ es.length ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < es.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' es[p + k]? = some
    e.Term') ∨ ∃ d, d < ents.length ∧ p + d ≤ es.length ∧ es' = List.take (p + d) es ++ List.drop d
    ents ∧ plogFindConflict { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es ents ≠ W64 0 ∧ uint.Z
    (plogFindConflict { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } es ents) = ↑p + ↑d + 1 ∧ (∀ (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < p + d → Option.map EntryM.Term' (List.take (p + d) es)[p +
    k]? = some e.Term') ∧ ∀ (n : Nat), p + d < n → n ≤ es.length → ¬∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
    ents[k]? = some e → p + k < n → Option.map EntryM.Term' (List.take n es)[p + k]? = some e.Term')

theorem TraceSim.mem_confAbs (C : List w64) (w : w64) : TraceSim.idAbs w ∈ TraceSim.confAbs C ↔ w ∈
    C

theorem TraceSim.newPending_send (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (p : Etcdraft.Msg → Bool)
    (hp : p m = true) : Etcdraft.newPending st (st.send m) p = true

theorem TraceSim.memEq_false_of_logs_or_term (visited : List Etcdraft.TState) (g : Etcdraft.TState)
    (i : Etcdraft.ID) (h : ∀ (v : Etcdraft.TState), v ∈ visited → i ∈ v.s.server ∧ ((v.s.s i).log ≠
    (g.s.s i).log ∨ TraceSim.srvKey (v.s.s i) ≠ TraceSim.srvKey (g.s.s i))) : Etcdraft.memEq visited
    g = false

theorem TraceSim.tallyGranted_quorum (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (g c : Etcdraft.SetIds) (hT :
    TraceSim.TallyGranted votes g) (hc : ∀ (k : w64) (w : Bool), votes !! k = some w →
    TraceSim.idAbs k ∈ c) (hq : Etcdraft.isQuorum (Etcdraft.SetIds.mk (List.map (fun p =>
    TraceSim.idAbs p.fst) (List.filter (fun p => p.snd) votes.toList))) c = true) :
    Etcdraft.isQuorum g c = true

theorem TraceSim.next_of_nonReceive (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (ts : Etcdraft.TState) (s2 :
    Etcdraft.State) (hl0 : ts.l ≠ 0) (hl : ts.l ≤ t.len) (hb : t.bootstrap.getD (ts.l - 1) false =
    false) (hrecv : Etcdraft.isReceiveName (t.line ts.l).ev.name = false) (hnr : t.nonReceive ts =
    Except.ok [s2]) : t.next ts = Except.ok [{ s := s2, l := ts.l + 1, pl := ts.l }]

theorem TraceSim.logOk_iff_upToDate (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (h : TraceSim.LogShapeOk
    bl s) (lt li : w64) : uint.Z lt > Etcdraft.lastTerm (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 s.log) ∨ uint.Z lt =
    Etcdraft.lastTerm (TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 s.log) ∧ uint.Z li ≥ ↑(TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1
    s.log).length ↔ plogUpToDate s.base s.log { term' := lt, index' := li } = true

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_none_len (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (index : Int) (m :
    Etcdraft.Msg) (hc : (st.s i).commitIndex < index) (hne : m.entries.isEmpty = false) (h :
    ¬m.prevLogIndex + ↑m.entries.length ≤ ↑(st.s i).log.length) : st.appendEntriesAlreadyDone i j
    index m = none

theorem TraceSim.alreadyDone_stale (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg)
    (index : Int) (hc : index ≤ (st.s i).commitIndex) (hsub : m.subtype ≠ "heartbeat") :

    Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype := m.subtype, term := (st.s i).currentTerm,
    success := true, matchIndex := (st.s i).commitIndex, source := i, dest := j } m)

    (List.filter P (TraceSim.confAbs C)).length = (List.filter (fun j => P (TraceSim.idAbs j))
    C).length

theorem TraceSim.truncSt_other (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j k : Etcdraft.ID) (L : List Etcdraft.Entry)
    (hk : k ≠ i) : (TraceSim.truncSt st i j L).s k = st.s k

    Role.candidate) (hty : m.ty = MsgType.voteResp) (hsrc : m.src = id) (hdst : m.dst = id) (hC : id

    m).get ⋯))

    w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (ht : uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64) : TraceSim.SimServerR
    C bl (pbecomeCandidate id s) { currentTerm := a.currentTerm + 1, state := Etcdraft.candidate,
    votedFor := TraceSim.idAbs id, lead := Etcdraft.nil, log := a.log, commitIndex := a.commitIndex,
    votesResponded := [], votesGranted := [], matchIndex := a.matchIndex, pendingConfChangeIndex :=
    a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.receive_staleAER (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest) (hterm : m.term
    < (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hpv : st.preVote = false) (hcq : st.checkQuorum = false) :
    st.receive m = Except.ok [st.reply { type := Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse, subtype :=
    "app", term := (st.s m.dest).currentTerm, source := m.dest, dest := m.source } m]

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_with_self (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) : (b.with m).count m =
    b.count m + 1

theorem TraceSim.sim_appResp (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) (src idx x
    : w64) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s a) (hx : s.matched !! src = some x) :
    TraceSim.SimServerR C bl { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes
    := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched :=
    <[src := if uint.Z x < uint.Z idx then idx else x]>s.matched, rd := s.rd } { currentTerm :=
    a.currentTerm, state := a.state, votedFor := a.votedFor, lead := a.lead, log := a.log,
    commitIndex := a.commitIndex, votesResponded := a.votesResponded, votesGranted :=
    a.votesGranted, matchIndex := fun k => if k = TraceSim.idAbs src then max (a.matchIndex
    (TraceSim.idAbs src)) (uint.Z idx) else a.matchIndex k, pendingConfChangeIndex :=
    a.pendingConfChangeIndex, config := a.config, durable := a.durable }

theorem TraceSim.foldlM_congr_mem {α β ε : Type} (f g : α → β → Except ε α) (l : List β) (a : α) :
    (∀ (a : α) (b : β), b ∈ l → f a b = g a b) → List.foldlM f a l = List.foldlM g a l

theorem TraceSim.advanceCommitIndex_noop (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (C : List w64) (hnd
    : C.Nodup) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (hR : TraceSim.SimServerR C bl s (st.s i)) (hl : s.role =
    Role.leader) (hs : TraceSim.LogShapeOk bl s) (N : w64) (hN : uint.Z N ≤ ↑s.log.length) (hq : 0 <
    uint.Z N → IsQuorum (listToSet C) (ackedBy s N)) (hmax : ∀ (k : Nat), uint.Z N < ↑k → k ≤
    s.log.length → ¬IsQuorum (listToSet C) (ackedBy s (W64 ↑k))) (hno : ¬(uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z N
    ∧ plogTermAt s.base s.log N = some s.term)) : st.advanceCommitIndex i = some (st.commitTo i
    (st.s i).commitIndex)

theorem TraceSim.becomeFollowerOfTerm_facts (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (T : Int) :
    (st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).server = st.server ∧ (st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).messages =
    st.messages ∧ ((st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).s i).state = Etcdraft.follower ∧
    ((st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).s i).currentTerm = T ∧ ((st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).s
    i).commitIndex = (st.s i).commitIndex ∧ ((st.becomeFollowerOfTerm i T).s i).log = (st.s i).log

theorem TraceSim.insertSorted_sorted' (id : Etcdraft.ID) (s : Etcdraft.SetIds) : List.Pairwise (fun
    x1 x2 => x1 < x2) s → List.Pairwise (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) (Etcdraft.insertSorted id s)

theorem TraceSim.oneLess_voteResp (st : Etcdraft.State) (i j : Etcdraft.ID) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hnd
    : st.messages.domain.Nodup) (hm : 0 < st.messages.count m) : Etcdraft.oneLessMessage st
    (TraceSim.voteRespResult st i j m) m = true

theorem TraceSim.hasNoConflict_abs (st : Etcdraft.State) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (C : List w64) (bl p :
    Nat) (es ents : List EntryM) (hl : (st.s i).log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 es) (hp : p ≤
    es.length) (hbl : TraceSim.BootTerms bl 1 es) (hbe : TraceSim.BootTerms bl (p + 1) ents) :
    st.hasNoConflict i (↑p + 1) (TraceSim.logAbs C bl (p + 1) ents) = true ↔ ∀ (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → p + k < es.length → Option.map EntryM.Term' es[p + k]? = some
    e.Term'

theorem TraceSim.logAbs_length (C : List w64) (bl first : Nat) (l : List EntryM) : (TraceSim.logAbs
    C bl first l).length = l.length

theorem TraceSim.foldlM_inv {α β ε : Type} (f : α → β → Except ε α) (P : α → Prop) (l : List β) (a r
    : α) : P a → (∀ (a : α) (b : β) (r : α), P a → f a b = Except.ok r → P r) → List.foldlM f a l =
    Except.ok r → P r

theorem TraceSim.chain_down (t : Etcdraft.Trace) (l0 : Nat) (i : Etcdraft.ID) (S : Nat →
    Etcdraft.State) (F : Nat → List Etcdraft.Entry) (q N : Nat) (tsF : Etcdraft.TState) (T : Int ×
    Etcdraft.Role) (hT : ∀ (k : Nat), TraceSim.srvKey ((S k).s i) = T) (hstep : ∀ (k : Nat), q < k →
    k ≤ N → t.next { s := S k, l := l0, pl := l0 } = Except.ok [{ s := S (k - 1), l := l0, pl := l0
    }]) (hsrv : ∀ (k : Nat), i ∈ (S k).server) (hlog : ∀ (k : Nat), ((S k).s i).log = F k) (hF : ∀
    (k k' : Nat), k ≤ N → k' ≤ N → k ≠ k' → F k ≠ F k') (hinv : ∀ (k : Nat), q ≤ k → k < N → (S
    k).violated = Except.ok none) (hbase : ∀ (visited : List Etcdraft.TState), (∀ (v :
    Etcdraft.TState), v ∈ visited → i ∈ v.s.server ∧ ((∃ k', q ≤ k' ∧ k' ≤ N ∧ (v.s.s i).log = F k')
    ∨ TraceSim.srvKey (v.s.s i) ≠ T)) → TraceSim.Chain t l0 visited { s := S q, l := l0, pl := l0 }
    tsF) (d : Nat) (visited : List Etcdraft.TState) : q + d ≤ N → (∀ (v : Etcdraft.TState), v ∈
    visited → i ∈ v.s.server ∧ ((∃ k', q + d ≤ k' ∧ k' ≤ N ∧ (v.s.s i).log = F k') ∨ TraceSim.srvKey
    (v.s.s i) ≠ T)) → TraceSim.Chain t l0 visited { s := S (q + d), l := l0, pl := l0 } tsF

theorem TraceSim.receive_appResp (st : Etcdraft.State) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (hsrv : List.contains
    st.server m.dest = true) (hty : m.type = Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse) (hterm : m.term
    = (st.s m.dest).currentTerm) (hsucc : m.success = true) : st.receive m = Except.ok
    [(TraceSim.withMatch st m.dest m.source m.matchIndex).discard m]
